headline: Hold at 8 of 8
paragraph: Quant Flow Capital tracks eight central banks across the globe as they meet to set monetary policy. Right now, all eight of these institutions are expected to hold their current interest rates steady. Among them, the Swiss National Bank stands out with a rate of 0.00%, while the others maintain higher levels.
